meta.name: reticle
meta.description: Install, instrument and verify this running web app from the inside (DOM, network, routing, console and framework state) instead of screenshots or guessing. Drives one real flow end to end and returns a verdict with the file:line to fix. Use when the user asks to set up or install Reticle, when a user-facing change needs proving before you call it done, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or when the user types /reticle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑通一遍真实用户操作流程,拿到哪里出问题、该改哪一行代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果代码改完想确认页面真的没坏,却不知道从哪查起。
copy.tagline_en: Run one real user flow in the browser and get the failing file and line to fix
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a code change needs proving the page still works before you ship.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会在你的 Web 应用里嵌入 Reticle 开发版 SDK,并当成 reticle_* 工具来用:从应用内部跑通一条真实流程,最后给出结论和要修的 file:line。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或配置 Reticle、需要证明某个面向用户的改动,或直接输入 /reticle 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Reticle 装到这个项目里
say.note: Claude 会自动跑 init 并接好 SDK

say.text: 跑一条流程验证:用户登录后能看到自己的订单
say.note: 它会驱动应用并给出结论

say.text: 我改了 src/App.tsx,帮我确认没弄坏别的
say.note: 只查改动文件,返回 file:line

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude embeds a dev-only Reticle SDK in your running web app and uses reticle_* tools to drive one real flow from inside it, then reports a verdict with the file:line to fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install or set up Reticle, when a user-facing change needs proving before it's called done, or when you type /reticle.

say_en.note: Runs init and wires the SDK

say_en.text: Verify a flow: a user logs in and sees their orders
say_en.note: It drives the app and returns a verdict

say_en.text: I changed src/App.tsx — did it break anything?
say_en.note: Checks only the changed files, with file:line
